messages:
maria: Heads up — I'm preparing to add aurora-3b-open to the model catalog. Quick status/questions below (short thread).
jason: Timeline?
maria: Targeting next Tue (2026-03-24). Need legal license signoff (anne), perf profile (leo), and a canary plan.
leo: Perf note: ran a sanity 1k sample pass on a single GPU; median token latency ~120ms at seq=256. Need full perf with seq=1024 + batch sweep. Example run: ```python
run_bench --model aurora-3b-open --seq 1024 --batch 8 --profile out.json\```
anne: License quick check: is upstream Apache-2.0 clean? Also saw a custom addendum in one fork — need canonical LICENSE file and SPDX ID to sign off. Also confirm any flagged training data (sensitive categories).
maria: License link: https://example.org/aurora/LICENSE (copied into manifest). Manifest tags: `training_data: web_crawl`, `contains_pii: no_known`. I pasted the LICENSE into the PR.
anne: I'll review the linked LICENSE and the manifest notes. If it's plain Apache-2.0 I'm ok, but if there's a non-derivative clause we can't ship. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
leo: One technical blocker: model uses rotary embeddings and our quant runner needs a tiny compile fallback to avoid NaNs in q4_0. I'll open a runtime PR.
maria: PR?
leo: PR #4123 — "runtime: rotary fallback for quant paths". Needs a couple quick reviews and a small unit test.
sam: I'll review the PR today. Also we need an eval plan: perplexity + rouge on catalog eval split and a small safety prompt set. Who hooks up the harness?
maria: I can wire aurora into the catalog eval harness (small run). Assigning to myself to produce perf + quality report by Mon AM.
rita: FYI — if you need extra eval throughput we can borrow a slot from the dedicated pool for a few hours. Ping me with desired timeframe.
jason: Product request: canary spec — 5% traffic for 48h with automated rollback if >=2% quality regression vs baseline. Is that feasible?
leo: Yes. We have routing policy tooling that supports percent rollouts + rollback hooks. Need both model variants: fp16 (baseline) and q4_0 (cheap). We'll publish both and configure fallback q4_0 -> fp16 on quality degradation.
maria: Action items (summary):
  - anne: license signoff (EOD tomorrow)
  - leo: full perf runs (seq=256/1024), open PR (today)
  - sam: CR review for #4123 and evaluation checks (today)
  - maria: run catalog evals + canary plan doc (Mon AM)
  - rita: standby for extra eval capacity (if requested)
jason: Add me as canary owner. Also need a short cost delta vs current default model in the catalog entry.
maria: Will add cost delta and update the PR description. :thumbsup:
release-bot: release-bot: SDK v0.9.3 has an embeddings shape fix (release notes: https://internal/release/0.9.3).
devex: I'll verify quickstart snippets and update the SDK example for aurora-3b-open embedding shape. ETA tomorrow morning.
maria: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a checklist in the catalog PR and ping again when the eval artifacts are uploaded.
maria: Pinning this thread to keep visibility :pushpin:
